tldr: Uranus in the 11th house: freedom becomes personal through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
body:
With Uranus in the 11th house, this part of you awakens through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans. Uranus describes freedom, disruption, originality, change, and the need to break from stale patterns. In practice, this brings attention to the people, audiences, collaborations, and shared futures you choose to belong to.

When this placement is supported, your place in a wider network can feel more meaningful and alive. Uranus can become honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small.

When it is strained, belonging can become performative, or a future plan can outgrow the people attached to it. The harder pattern can show up as instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point.
gift: honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small expressed through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
challenge: instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point around friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
